# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Billy is described as a heavy, slow-moving young man with a broad, round, fat face. He has large, vacant-looking blue eyes and a perpetually pleasant but somewhat vacant expression. His physical presence is solid and unhurried, matching his sluggish demeanor.

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, good-natured, and exceptionally quiet, often finding it difficult to hold a conversation. He lacks wit and imagination, preferring comfortable silence to social engagement. Though kind-hearted and well-meaning, he is entirely unromantic and straightforward. His utter bashfulness is so pronounced that he relies on his sister to propose marriage on his behalf.

## Traits

- Extremely shy
- Good-natured
- Slow-witted
- Taciturn

## Abilities

- Farming

## Goals

- To settle down and maintain a comfortable home in Avonlea

## History

Billy Andrews grows up in Avonlea as a neighbor and schoolmate of Anne Shirley. As a young man, he decides he wants to marry Anne, but his extreme shyness prevents him from courting her directly. Instead, he sends his sister, Jane Andrews, to propose to Anne on his behalf. Anne promptly and firmly declines the proposal, which Billy accepts without much heartbreak or distress. He later moves on and marries Nettie Blewett, settling down into a conventional life in Avonlea.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the prominent Andrews family, living near Green Gables.
- Attended the Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her peers.

## Affiliations

- The Andrews Family — Son and brother
